newsitem.title: USA: SyQuest names director, global executive.
newsitem.headline: SyQuest names director, global executive.

text.p: SyQuest Technology Inc said it had appointed electronics industry veteran Joseph Baia to its board of directors and former industry executive Joe Smith executive vice president of its global operations.
The board appointment fills the seat left vacant by the resignation of SyQuest's founder, Syet Iftikar, in mid-August and adds additional operations experience, the company said.
Baia spent 18 years as co-founder, vice chairman and a member of the board of directors of Western Digital Corp.
SyQuest chairman Ed Marinaro said Baia's experience "will help us aggressively compete for greater market share."
Smith was vice president of operations at Western Digital Corp over the last five years and vice president of operations for Conner Peripherals.
Shares of SyQuest closed on Thursday at 6-3/16, down 1/16.
